title: The 'read the true record, and swear it' option at the Oath-Ground listed only relationship deltas (Tamsin +1, Brother Osk -1, Vell -2) but did not warn that Vell would actually leave the party as a mechanical consequence, not just lose regard. Had to spend an extra turn re-recruiting them.
